scopeNotes: All new resource cases use the same owned HTTPS origin, including raw. Older HTTP-origin results are not a matched comparator.
Each API/protocol case uses a separate fresh CI emulator. Single sequential windows and differing VMs do not establish causal incremental cost or a universal protocol ranking.

VLESS raw TCP, no Vision/Mux; TLS fixture uses the same self-signed RSA authority for owned node/origin. Public PKI chains, HTTP2 origins, WAN conditions, real ChatGPT and arm64 physical devices are unverified.
CI trust exists only in ci source sets/resources. Preview APK gate checks absence of generated authority resources and class. Verification is not disabled and failed identities cannot become direct.

The initial HTTP1.0 synthetic origin produced Android native HTTPS POST EOF after successful downloads. Canonical HTTP1.1 finite close framing and complete response writes were added; repeated HTTPS control and all six device suites then passed. This does not prove a universal HTTP1.0 client defect.
